text:
Eli (AE): @Devon @Maria quick heads up — Contoso approved POC budget but Procurement flagged a few items:
1) payment terms on our order form (they want net30 instead of our standard net45 for enterprise deals),
2) DPA subprocessor language (they asked for an approved list and shorter notice), and
3) they need a stamped MSA by EOW to proceed with PO. Can we triage?

Devon (SE): POC capacity note — need to confirm expected qps and token mix. If they want Dedicated GPUs after POC, pricing uplift for reserved capacity is ~18% on top of the published ratecard (depends on GPU type). For pure POC (non-reserved) we can keep standard hosted rates. I'll ask infra about immediate availability. Also request: Contoso to fill our security questionnaire (SSQ) so we can validate subproc concerns.

Maria (Legal): On DPA/subproc — we can accept a bounded subprocessor list plus a 30-day posted notice and right to object. I'll propose the following redline snippet and circulate a tracked version:

```
DPA, Section 4.2: Supplier will maintain a list of Subprocessors and provide Customer with written notice at least thirty (30) days prior to engaging a new Subprocessor. Customer will have the right to object on reasonable security/compliance grounds; parties will use good faith efforts to resolve objections.
```

Also: remove the broad indemnity expansion in section 9; we can offer a 90-day cure period instead of immediate termination. I can get a tracked MSA+clean by EOD if we have PO and billing contact.

Jen (Contracts): Signature path — are they DocuSign customers? If yes, we can route MSA -> Order Form -> SOW via DocuSign. Need signer name + email and whether they require countersignature location. Also confirm whether Contoso requires a PO number on the first invoice.

Sam (Finance): Net30 is doable for POC-only engagements. For Dedicated reserved capacity we need a 30% upfront commitment against the first invoice (standard for capacity commits). We also require vendor tax form (W-9/equivalent) and billing contact to set them up. If they insist on net45 for Dedicated, escalate to Revenue Ops for credit review.

Claudia (Contoso): FYI — Legal at Contoso is willing to accept 30-day notice for subprocessors but wants an explicit SLA >99.5% for Dedicated and priority support during onboarding. They prefer a single monthly invoice.

Devon (SE): We can commit to 99.5% for Dedicated with the premium support add-on. For the POC we can include a temporary SOW SLA that maps to our standard hosted SLOs. Action: I will draft a short SOW listing expected qps, token estimates, and two pricing options (POC hosted vs Dedicated reserved) and include sequence length assumptions.

Eli (AE): Action items summarized:
• @Devon — draft SOW + two pricing options (POC hosted / Dedicated reserved) and capacity assumptions by EOD.
• @Maria — send DPA + MSA quick redlines and attach tracked and clean copies by EOD.
• @Jen — confirm DocuSign path and recipient emails; confirm whether order form can require PO on sign.
• @Sam — confirm upfront requirement for Dedicated and outline billing onboarding checklist.
• @Claudia — ask Contoso to complete our security questionnaire and provide signer/email + PO timing.

InfraBot: Note — tentative Dedicated capacity window available next week for limited POC bursts. Confirmed GPU pool: a100-80gb x2 available 2026-09-14 -> 2026-09-21 (subject to booking). :rocket:

Eli (AE): Thanks all — I'll update the opportunity and ping Contoso for the questionnaire. If anyone has objections to the proposed DPA snippet above, reply here. :thumbsup:
